creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found in review, round 1 (2026-09-24). When ~/.muster/state/holding/tabs.toml does not parse, change() in crates/muster-seam/src/holding.rs writes the window's in-memory copy back over it. Today only a corrupt file reaches that path. Once the record's format changes, an older Muster still running beside a newer one would overwrite the newer file and drop whatever it does not know. Refuse to write a record this version cannot read, and say so in the run log.
title: A window that cannot read the tab record writes over it
